notes: Recorded 17 bachelor programmes, which is the full undergraduate list of the KIMEP Catalog 2026-2027 (BCB 4, CSS 5, Law School 2, CHSE 4, SCSM 2). The source states no total number.

The grant page and the admission page use slightly different names (for example 'Public and Local Administration', 'Accounting and Audit'); the catalogue names are used here. The admission page for school graduates does not list Political Science, but the catalogue does.
The grant page says it applies to undergraduate admission without naming a field limit; whether all 17 programmes are open to the 10 grants is not itemised.
